name: Crown and Conflict: The Tudors and Stuarts
description: Two centuries of English kings and queens, from Bosworth to Queen Anne, with plots, religion, civil war, regicide and revolution.

checkpoints.name: Roses end at Bosworth
checkpoints.note: Richard III dies at Bosworth in 1485 and Henry Tudor wins the crown, ending the Wars of the Roses and founding a dynasty that restores order.

checkpoints.name: Henry VIII and his heirs
checkpoints.note: Henry VIII breaks with Rome and closes the monasteries. His son Edward VI pushes Protestant reform, Jane Grey reigns briefly, and Mary I turns back to Catholicism.

checkpoints.name: The Elizabethan age
checkpoints.note: Elizabeth I settles the church, sends Mary of Scotland to the block, beats the Spanish Armada and presides over a flowering of English drama and exploration.

checkpoints.name: Stuarts, war and republic
checkpoints.note: James I unites the crowns and survives a gunpowder plot. His son Charles I loses a civil war and his head, and Oliver Cromwell rules England as Lord Protector.

checkpoints.name: Restoration and revolution
checkpoints.note: Charles II returns to the throne, James II is driven out in the Glorious Revolution, William and Mary accept the Bill of Rights, and Anne sees the union with Scotland.
